entities.summary: Malvika Wanem subba (Limbu) (Nepali: माल्बिका वनेम सुब्बा (लिम्बु)) is a Nepalese television personality, entrepreneur, model, social activist and beauty pageant title holder who was crowned Miss Nepal 2002. She graduated from Pokhara University with Masters in Mass Communication and Journalism.
